blood-lactate-rest.label: Blood lactate at rest
blood-lactate-rest.value: about 1 mmol·L⁻¹ (0.84 mmol·L⁻¹ in one tracer study)

whole-blood-plasma-lactate.label: Whole-blood lactate relative to plasma lactate
whole-blood-plasma-lactate.value: about 70% of the plasma value, at rest and in most exercise

mlss-lactate-range.label: Blood lactate at the maximal lactate steady state (MLSS)
mlss-lactate-range.value: about 1.5–7 mmol·L⁻¹ between people, average about 3.7

lactate-peak-after-max.label: Peak blood lactate after a 30–120 s all-out effort
lactate-peak-after-max.value: about 15–25 mmol·L⁻¹, reached 3–8 min after the effort

lactate-oxidised-exercise.label: Share of removed blood lactate that is oxidised
lactate-oxidised-exercise.value: about half at rest, about 87% during exercise (one tracer study)
